samples.xml_description:
<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>Serial-to-Parallel Conversion Circuit</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data.</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        Always block triggered on positive edges of clk or negative edges of rst_n.
        
        Internal register cnt used to keep track of the current bit position in the input serial data. It starts at 0 and increments by 1 after each input bit has been processed.
        
        Conditional statements check if rst_n is active low or if din_valid is high to determine the next value of cnt.
        
        Sequential logic block for dout_parallel: Outputs the input din_serial at the correct index based on the value of cnt.
        
        Combinational logic block for dout_valid: Checks if cnt equals 7 to determine if the output data is valid. If so, it sets dout_valid to 1; otherwise, it sets dout_valid to 0.
        
        Additional conditional statements handle special cases where dout_parallel should be initialized to 0 or left unchanged when cnt does not equal 0.
    </implementation>
</module>
